ety.hint: A street vendor talks 口 incessantly, like a bird 隹

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning, calling out wares, plus the sound part 雔 (pair of birds), shortened to a single 隹 (bird): to sell.

ety.hint: A hand 舛 holding a fan

origin.says: A shortened 無 (once a picture of a dancer) as the sound plus 舛 (two feet) for the meaning: a new character made to keep 無's first sense, to dance.

扩.def: to expand, to stretch, to magnify

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 廣 (wide) as the sound, now written 广: to stretch wider by hand. Simplified from 擴.

扩.name: expand

授.def: to award, to confer, to instruct, to teach

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 受 (receive) as the sound: to give, the other side of receiving, hence to award and to teach.

授.name: confer

origin.says: Origin unclear. One reading sees a hand pushing something across, 'to give'; another links it to 余 (I), as it also wrote 'I, me'.

赢.def: to win, to gain; surplus, profit

origin.says: 贝 (cowry money) for the meaning, set inside a sound part (亡 'perish', 口 'mouth', 月 'moon', 凡 'ordinary' around it): gaining money, profit, to win. Simplified by writing 貝 as 贝.

赢.name: win money

迫.def: to compel, to force; pressing, urgent

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: to come close, to press in on, hence to force.

迫.name: compel

申.def: to report; to extend; to explain; to declare

origin.says: A drawing of a lightning bolt, the original form of 電 (lightning) and 神 (god). It was borrowed for 'extend, state, report'.

申.name: declare

疑.def: to doubt, to question, to suspect

ety.hint: An old man walking 疋 while holding 匕 a cane 矢

origin.says: First a drawing of a man with a cane looking round with open mouth, unsure which way to go; a foot and a sound part were added later. The parts have since broken into 匕 (spoon), 矢 (arrow) and 疋 (foot).

疑.name: doubt

origin.says: Simplified from 漸: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 斩 (to chop) as the sound. Water soaking in slowly gives 'gradually'.
⺖ (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 圣 (the old 'dig' character, not 'sage') as the sound: what the mind finds odd, strange.
Simplified from 亂, whose left part showed two hands untangling threads and whose right part 乚 was added: disorder. The simplified form writes the left part as 舌 (tongue), only a look-alike.
Probably a drawing of a corridor leading to a room (the word later written 廊, corridor); used for the word 'good'. It is unrelated to 艮 (stubborn), which it only resembles.
广 (building) for the meaning plus 予 (give) as the sound: first the side walls of a hall, then the order of things, and a preface.
A drawing of a cliff overhang. The simplified script also uses it for 廠 (factory: 广 building + 敞 as the sound), taking over this old character's shape.

厂.name: factory
厂.in: 原历源愿压危顾励厅厌厉岸厚厦厕厨脆跪厘涯厢崖诡橱赡瞻雳雁檐扼沥

载.def: load; to carry, to convey, to transport

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 𢦏 as the sound: to load a cart, to carry; also to record. Simplified from 載 by writing 車 (cart) as 车.

载.name: cartload

摄.def: to absorb, to take in; to photograph; to act on behalf of

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 聂 (whisper) as the sound: to take hold of, to take in; now also to take a photo. Simplified from 攝 with 聶 shortened to 聂.

摄.name: take in

透.def: to pierce, to penetrate, to pass through; thorough

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 秀 (bloom) as the sound: to pass right through, to penetrate.

透.name: pass through

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: a big river, above all the Yangtze.
Disputed: one reading takes 八 (divide) for the meaning plus 向 (toward) as the sound; another sees a drawing of a raised hall or platform. Meanings: to esteem, and 'still, yet'.

尚.name: esteem
尚.in: 常堂掌赏撑躺敞倘趟膛裳淌棠

ety.hint: Two hands 八 holding a book 冊

origin.says: 冊 (bamboo book) placed on 丌 (table): important official books on a stand, hence canon and law. The modern shape has blurred the book and the table.
Simplified from 億: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 意 (thought) as the sound, which was replaced by the simpler 乙 (second), also a sound part: a hundred million.
口 (mouth) for an exclamation plus 我 (I) as the sound: the interjection 'oh!' of realising or acknowledging.

ety.hint: Older than 丨 the sun 日

origin.says: From 舊: an owl 雈 (owl) with 臼 (mortar) as the sound; the owl word was borrowed for a sound-alike meaning 'old'. The simplified form replaces the owl with one stroke and the mortar with 日 (sun).

ety.hint: A bird 鸟 perched atop a mountain 山

origin.says: From 島: 鳥 (bird) as the sound with 山 (mountain): a mountain in the sea where birds rest, an island. 鳥 became 鸟 and its bottom stroke is shared with 山.

避.def: to avoid, to turn away; to escape, to hide

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: to walk away from something, to avoid.

避.name: avoid

origin.says: A late character for a spoken particle: 口 (mouth) marks a sound of speech, 麻 (hemp) gives the sound ma.

召.def: imperial decree; to summon, to call, to beckon

origin.says: 刀 (knife) as the sound plus 口 (mouth): to call out, to summon. The oldest oracle-bone forms were different (hands over a wine vessel), so the build is partly a later one.

召.name: summon

origin.says: 阝 (mound, wall) for the meaning plus 章 (chapter) as the sound: an earth wall that blocks, a barrier, an obstacle.
人 (person, written 几 at the bottom) under the top of 京 (tall building), which also gives the sound: a person up high in the light, bright. One reading sees an oil lamp instead.

ety.hint: A man with head 日 and hands 共 tormenting a deer 水

origin.says: Disputed: one reading sees 日 (sun), two hands and 米 (rice) laid out to dry, 'expose to sun'; the oldest form showed 虎 (tiger) and 戈 (weapon), 'violence'. The rice became 氺 (water).

翻.def: to upset, to capsize, to flip over

origin.says: 番 (turn) as the sound plus 羽 (wings): wings fluttering and flapping over, hence to flip over, to capsize; later also to translate.

翻.name: flip over

origin.says: 艹 (grass, plants) for the meaning plus 早 (early) as the sound: grass. The character first meant an acorn dye and was borrowed for grass, replacing the older 艸 (grass).

露.def: dew; leak; bare, exposed; to reveal, to show

origin.says: 雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 路 (road) as the sound: dew, water that settles from the air; also exposed, to show.

露.name: dew

违.def: to violate, to disobey, to defy; to separate from

origin.says: Simplified from 違: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 韦 (leather) as the sound: walking away from, going against, to disobey.

违.name: disobey

宗.def: ancestry, clan, family, lineage; religion, sect

ety.hint: An altar 示 to the ancestor spirits found in one's home 宀

origin.says: 宀 (house) over 示 (spirit tablet, altar): the hall where ancestors are worshipped, hence clan, lineage and religious sect.

宗.name: ancestral shrine

ety.hint: A violent 暴 flame 火; 暴 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 暴 (violent) as the sound, which also helps the meaning: fire bursting, to explode.

守.def: to defend, to guard, to protect; to conserve; to wait

ety.hint: Keeping something 寸 within one's walls 宀

origin.says: 宀 (roof, building) over 寸 (hand): a hand keeping watch over a building, to guard. 寸 may also hint at the sound.

守.name: keep watch

呼.def: to breathe, to exhale, to sigh; to call, to shout

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 乎 (an exclaiming particle) as the sound: breath or a shout going out of the mouth.

呼.name: exhale

赶.def: to pursue, to overtake; to hurry; to expel

origin.says: Simplified from 趕: 走 (walk, run) for the meaning plus 旱 (drought) as the sound, to chase or hurry. The simplified form swaps the sound part 旱 for the simpler 干 (shield), which sounds alike.

赶.name: hurry

origin.says: Simplified from 勵: 厲 (whetstone, severe), now 厉, as the sound plus 力 (strength): to urge on, to encourage.
Simplified from 樓: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 婁 (Lou) as the sound, written 娄: a timber building of several floors.
First written 輭: 車 (cart) for the meaning plus 耎 (soft) as the sound; a popular variant turned 耎 into 欠 (yawn), giving 軟, then 车 (short cart). Why the cart is unclear.

竞.def: to compete, to contend, to vie

ety.hint: To stand up 立 to a foe 兄

origin.says: Traditional 競 shows two people side by side arguing or racing. The simplified form keeps only one half, which looks like 立 (stand) over 兄 (elder brother).

竞.name: compete

origin.says: 明 (bright) as the sound plus 皿 (dish) for the meaning: the dish of blood shared when swearing an oath, an alliance. The oldest forms differ in which part gives the sound.

ety.hint: A child standing 立 in the village 里

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show a chisel 辛 (chisel) over an eye: a servant or slave marked by punishment; bronze forms added 東 (east) for the sound. Over time 辛 shrank to 立 (stand) and 東 with 土 (earth) became 里 (village). 'Servant boy' later became 'child'.

脱.def: to take off, to shed; to escape from

origin.says: ⺼ (flesh, body) for the meaning plus 兑 (exchange) as the sound: flesh coming loose; to shed, take off, escape.

脱.name: take off

origin.says: 犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 句 (hooked) as the sound, which may also suggest "small": first a young or small dog, now any dog.
A fairly late character: ⺖ (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 董 (supervise) as the sound: to understand.
Early forms look like a hut or roofed shelter. The character was borrowed for the number six for its sound; the hut meaning was lost.

六.name: six
六.in: 交较校效咬郊胶饺狡跤冥绞

痛.def: ache, pain; bitterness, sorrow; deeply, thoroughly

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 甬 (bell) as the sound: pain, ache; from that sorrow and 'thoroughly'.

痛.name: pain

ety.hint: A heart 忄 faced with death 亡; 亡 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: ⺖ (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 亡 (lose) as the sound: a mind that is lost in hurry, busy. A twin word of 忘 (forget).

忘.def: to forget, to miss, to neglect, to overlook

origin.says: 亡 (lose) as the sound plus 心 (heart, mind) for the meaning: gone from the mind, to forget.

忘.name: forget

遭.def: to meet, to encounter, to come across

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 曹 (officials) as the sound: to meet with something on the road, to encounter.

遭.name: run into

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: a bitter plant, then bitter taste and hardship.

Today read as 木 (tree) plus 子 (child, seed): the plum tree, later a very common surname. Oracle-bone forms instead show 來 (wheat) as the sound, which wore down into 木, so the old dictionary reading is doubted.
Simplified from 靈 (spirit): 霝 (falling rain) as the sound plus 巫 (shaman), or earlier 玉 (jade). The simplified form swaps them for 彐 (hand) over 火 (fire), an old popular form.

ety.hint: 厶 provides the meaning and pronunciation

origin.says: 厶 (private), the original character for the word, as the sound, with 禾 (grain) added later: one's own grain, hence private and selfish.
Simplified from 額 (頁 became 页): 客 (guest) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: the forehead; later a fixed amount, a quota.

块.def: piece, lump, chunk; dollar; measure word for currency

origin.says: Simplified from 塊: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 鬼 (ghost) as the sound, a clod of earth. The simplified form uses the simpler 夬 (parting) as the sound part, an old variant.

块.name: lump

origin.says: A drawing of a small thatched hut (the word later written 舍, house), borrowed for 'I' and in simplified writing also for 餘 (surplus; 食 food + 余 as the sound). Its parts now look like 人 (person) over 示 (altar).
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 仓 (granary) as the sound: first a wooden spear, now a gun. Simplified from 槍, with 倉 (granary) shortened to 仓.

促.def: to urge, to rush, to hurry; hasty; near, close

ety.hint: Someone 亻 on your heels 足; 足 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 足 (foot) as the sound: someone close on your heels, pressing you to hurry.

促.name: hurry up

ety.hint: Known 知 clearly 日; 知 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: First the same character as 知 (know); a 甘 (sweet) part was added, which turned into 日 (sun) below 知: wisdom, intelligence.

封.def: envelope, letter; to confer, to grant; feudal

ety.hint: To seal 寸 something with a handful of mortar 土

origin.says: First 丰 (a seedling) planted in 土 (earth) by 寸 (a hand): to plant a boundary tree, to grant land, then to seal. The seedling has turned into a second 土 (earth), so the left side now looks like 圭 (jade tablet).

封.name: seal

弃.def: to abandon, to discard, to reject; to desert; to forget

ety.hint: Two hands 廾 discarding a dead, swaddled baby 亠厶

origin.says: From 棄: an upside-down 子 (child) in a basket held by 廾 (two hands): throwing out a child, to abandon. The simplified form drops the basket and keeps the upside-down child (亠 over 厶) above 廾.

弃.name: abandon

origin.says: 孰 (first meaning cooked) for the sound and meaning plus 灬 (fire): cooked over fire, then ripe, mature, familiar.

索.def: cable, rope; rules, laws; to demand, to exact; to search, to inquire

ety.hint: A rope 糸 hanging from the ceiling 冖

origin.says: 糸 (thread) inside a frame of hands or hemp stalks: twisting fibres into a big rope. From rope came to bind, to search, to demand. One reading sees two hands, another stripped hemp.

索.name: rope

挑.def: to select, to choose; picky, choosy; a load

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 兆 (omen) as the sound: to pick out with the hand, to choose; also to carry on a pole.

挑.name: pick

ety.hint: A woman 女 holding a broom 十 in her hand 彐

origin.says: A hand (又 (hand)) grasping a woman's hair or hair ornament over 女 (woman); one reading is marriage by capture, another a woman putting up her hair as a wife. The hand part is no longer a character.

惊.def: to frighten, to startle; surprise, alarm

origin.says: The traditional 驚 had 馬 (horse, easily startled) with 敬 (respect) as the sound. The simplified form takes an old variant instead: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 京 (capital) as the sound: a startled heart.

惊.name: startle

堂.def: hall, large room; government office; cousins

origin.says: 尚 (esteem, perhaps a raised hall) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: a hall built up on a raised earth platform.

堂.name: hall

origin.says: Simplified from 廳: 广 (building) for the meaning and 聽 (listen) for the sound, a hall where matters were heard. The new form takes 厂 (cliff shelter) for the building and 丁 (nail) as a simpler sound part.

炸.def: to explode; to fry in oil; to scald

ety.hint: A sudden 乍 flame 火; 乍 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 乍 (suddenly) as the sound, which fits a sudden burst of flame: to explode; to deep-fry.

炸.name: deep-fry

估.def: merchant; to estimate, to guess, to presume

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: a person who sets prices, a merchant, then to estimate.

估.name: estimate

origin.says: Simplified from 蘭: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 闌 as the sound: the orchid. The simplified form keeps the plant part as 丷 and uses 三 (three) as the sound.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 異; a person 共 with a scary face田

origin.says: Stands for 異, a person with a mask over the face: strange, different. Simplification took over an old character 异, 廾 (two hands) with 巳 as the sound, meaning 'to raise'.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 曼 (vast, extended) as the sound and a hint: water spreading far, overflowing; hence unrestrained, aimless, and too much.

ety.hint: A chalice 皿 filled with blood 丿

origin.says: A drop of blood (the top stroke) in a sacrificial vessel 皿 (dish): blood offered in rites.

延.def: to defer, to delay, to postpone; to extend, to prolong; surname

ety.hint: A foot on the road 㢟 stopped in its tracks 丿

origin.says: Originally 㢟: walking (彳, now 廴) plus a foot (止), to travel far. A slanting stroke was later added on top to mark the sense prolonged. In the modern shape the stroke and the foot have fused into one piece.

延.name: prolong
